description: This file defines utility functions and templates for parsing, loading, and manipulating JSON data within the 'cuttlefish' namespace. It includes functions for parsing JSON strings, loading JSON from files, converting JSON values to specific types, retrieving nested values, and checking for the existence of values.

methods.name: ParseJson
methods.description: Parses a JSON string input and returns a Result containing the Json::Value.

methods.name: LoadFromFile
methods.description: Loads JSON data from a file descriptor or file path, returning a Result with the Json::Value.

methods.name: As
methods.description: Template functions to convert a Json::Value to a specific type, with specializations for int, std::string, bool, and Json::Value.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves a nested value from a JSON object based on a sequence of selectors, converting it to a specified type.

methods.name: GetArrayValues
methods.description: Extracts an array of values from a JSON array, applying selectors to each element.

methods.name: HasValue
methods.description: Checks whether a nested value exists within a JSON object based on a sequence of selectors.
